summary: shadowmd ships char-code-obfuscated network host in Socket messages-send path
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js at lines 425 and 436 reconstructs the URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/ from a String.fromCharCode decimal-ASCII array rather than a plain string literal. The host is assembled inside the package's WhatsApp socket message-send code path, so on every message-send flow the runtime resolves to an off-host destination whose identity is hidden from source-level inspection. Obfuscated destination reconstruction in a messaging library's send path is the fingerprint of a Baileys-family fork that intercepts or mirrors session/message data through an author-controlled endpoint; the destination fiora.nixel.my.id is unrelated to the WhatsApp protocol and is not documented as a caller-configurable endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
